theme: European STR registration and tourist-accommodation registries (Portugal RNAL, Spain tourist dwellings, Italy CIN, France meublés de tourisme, Amsterdam, Berlin, Vienna, Lisbon, Barcelona HUTB, Paris)

candidates.name: Inquilinato-Cadiz/mapa
candidates.what_it_holds: Static site + daily-refreshed pull from OpenRTA (Registro de Turismo de Andalucía, CC BY 4.0 open-data API) covering all 45 municipalities of Cádiz province, Spain: per-municipality GeoJSON of registered tourist-use dwellings (public/data/municipios/<slug>.geojson), plus data/fincas-cadiz.csv joined from Spain's Dirección General del Catastro (cadastral office), regenerated monthly via GitHub Actions. src/data/municipios.json and stats.json hold rollup indices. 23 commits, last commit 8 Sep 2026.
candidates.why_useful: A live, machine-pullable, daily-updated registry of licensed short-term rentals for an entire Spanish province (Andalucía coastal tourism market), joined to cadastral ownership data — directly extends gap 12 (city registration datasets) beyond the Barcelona HUTB/municipal set we already hold, and the underlying OpenRTA API (Junta de Andalucía) plausibly covers all of Andalucía (Málaga, Sevilla, Granada, etc.), not just Cádiz.
candidates.geography: Cádiz province, Andalucía, Spain (45 municipalities); underlying OpenRTA API is region-wide Andalucía
candidates.time_coverage: current snapshot, refreshed daily/monthly (no historical vintages stored, but a fork could snapshot it)
candidates.size_hint: province-wide GeoJSON per municipality + one cadastral CSV; OpenRTA API capped at 10,000 records/request
candidates.license: OpenRTA data CC BY 4.0; cadastral data unspecified; repo license not stated

candidates.name: cadiz-resiste/openrta-tools
candidates.what_it_holds: Python tooling (rta2map.py) plus committed JSON snapshots (rta_cadiz.json, rta_bahia.json, rta_elpuerto.json) of the Junta de Andalucía tourism registry (OpenRTA / VUT — viviendas de uso turístico) for Cádiz city, the Bay of Cádiz, and El Puerto de Santa María; renders to HTML maps distinguishing tourist housing vs tourist apartments. 7 commits, small.
candidates.why_useful: Companion/earlier version of the OpenRTA pipeline above; committed JSON snapshots give a point-in-time cut of the same Andalucía STR registry usable without re-querying the API.
candidates.geography: Cádiz city, Bahía de Cádiz, El Puerto de Santa María (Andalucía, Spain)
candidates.time_coverage: single/few snapshots, undated in visible metadata
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: overlaps Inquilinato-Cadiz/mapa (same OpenRTA source, narrower geography, older snapshot)

candidates.name: cadiz-resiste/openrta-maps
candidates.what_it_holds: Code to generate interactive maps from OpenRTA VUT (viviendas de uso turístico) data for Cádiz-area municipalities; Apache-2.0 licensed.
candidates.why_useful: Another entry point into the same Andalucía OpenRTA STR registry with a permissive license, useful if the .json data snapshots differ in date from openrta-tools.

candidates.name: cadiz-resiste/openrta-excel
candidates.what_it_holds: Excel workbooks analysing the Junta de Andalucía tourism registry (same OpenRTA source as the other cadiz-resiste repos).
candidates.why_useful: Possible additional cut/vintage of the Andalucía STR registry in spreadsheet form.

candidates.name: diagmatrix/tourism-watcher
candidates.what_it_holds: Selenium-based scraper monitoring Airbnb listings alongside public tourism-permit registry data for Granada, Spain; collects from ~15 Oct 2024 onward; data stored under a data/ folder; 18 commits; GPL-3.0.
candidates.why_useful: Combines a public STR registry pull with an Airbnb listing scrape for one Spanish city — a method template for cross-checking registration counts against live listing counts (relevant to the RNPL/registration-coverage question), though it does touch airbnb.com and any run decision is a human call per repo rules.

candidates.name: Newtral-datos/mapa_vivienda_turistica_temporada
candidates.what_it_holds: Spanish data-journalism outlet Newtral's interactive map of seasonal/tourist housing in Spain; ships a vector-tile file mapa_rua.pmtiles plus config.js/index.html; 14 commits; no stated license or description on the repo page (source dataset behind the map not confirmed from README alone).
candidates.why_useful: A committed geospatial vector-tile dataset of Spanish tourist-housing distribution from a national newsroom's data team — worth a closer look to confirm the underlying registry source (likely INE/regional cadastro) and whether the pmtiles file can be queried offline for counts by municipality.
candidates.size_hint: one pmtiles vector-tile file, size unknown

candidates.name: nilovam30-ai/dee-airbnb-valencia
candidates.what_it_holds: Geospatial analysis of tourist dwellings (viviendas turísticas) and residential rent pressure in València, Spain.
candidates.why_useful: Possible additional Spanish-city STR registry/geospatial dataset beyond Barcelona/Cádiz; would need a repo-content check to confirm source registry vs. Inside Airbnb re-use.

candidates.name: DavidDeVegaMartin/Alquiler_Vivienda_Turistica
candidates.what_it_holds: 'Discovery Insights' student/portfolio project on Madrid tourist rentals sourced from Idealista; includes a Datos folder, Jupyter notebooks, and a presentation; 4 commits.
candidates.why_useful: Small Idealista-sourced Madrid tourist-rental dataset; marginal size but a real non-Kaggle, non-Inside-Airbnb source (Idealista) relevant to housing-crossover gap 13.

candidates.name: JCaceres-R/DataJam-Turismo-Vivienda
candidates.what_it_holds: Bogotá, Colombia DataJam 2026 project pulling 7 datasets from Bogotá's open-data portal (datosabiertos.bogota.gov.co): tourist-housing (Airbnb-type) registrations, Tourist Interest Zones (ZIT) from the spatial plan, household/housing projections, municipal boundaries, cadastral valuations, tourist accommodations, and gastronomy/bar locations; raw + processed CSVs; one clustering analysis over 309 cadastral sectors; 16 commits.
candidates.why_useful: Not European, but directly on-theme for STR registration/registry data and fills LatAm gap 7 (Colombia) with an official government tourist-housing registry pull plus zoning/cadastral cross-reference — a template method transferable to the European registries.
candidates.size_hint: 7 open-data extracts, 309 cadastral sectors in one analysis

candidates.name: Niteowlpt/conforme-pt-toolkit
candidates.what_it_holds: Apache-2.0 Python toolkit implementing Portuguese short-term-rental regulatory compliance logic: RNAL, SIBA (Lei 23/2007) guest-reporting, AT Modelo 30 tax form, and municipal tourist-tax arithmetic. No committed registry data; encodes the rules/fields RNAL registrations must carry.
candidates.why_useful: No dataset, but documents the RNAL registration schema and municipal tourist-tax rules precisely enough to help interpret or reverse-engineer any future scrape of Portugal's national RNAL public register.
candidates.time_coverage: n/a (compliance code, not a time series)

notes: WebSearch was fully exhausted (shared session budget) before this scout got a single query through. DuckDuckGo (both html. and lite.) returned only bot-CAPTCHA pages — unusable. Bing via WebFetch returned generically irrelevant results even with site:github.com filters (the summarizer model appears to see Bing's non-JS fallback SERP, which doesn't honor site: well for these European-language queries) — unusable. Ecosia returned 403. github.com/search (web UI) was rate-limited (429) on every attempt. Fell back heavily on `gh search repos` (GitHub code-search API), which worked but is a very sparse index for non-English, non-code-flavoured queries and hit its own 403 rate limit repeatedly (shared across all 20+ scouts hitting it concurrently) — three planned queries (Paris logement meublé, Italy CIN struttura ricettiva, codice identificativo nazionale) never completed before I stopped to consolidate. Net effect: this theme is genuinely underserved on GitHub relative to Inside-Airbnb-style US repos — real STR-registry data lives natively as government open-data-portal APIs (OpenRTA/Andalucía, data.gouv.fr, dati.gov.it, Barcelona/Lisbon municipal portals), and the GitHub layer is mostly thin client/compliance tooling (found for Portugal) or one-off scraped mirrors (found only for Spain: Cádiz/Andalucía OpenRTA cluster, Granada, Valencia, Madrid). I found ZERO usable GitHub repos for France (meublés de tourisme), Italy (CIN), Amsterdam, Berlin, or Vienna specifically — every query for those either came back empty or the search channel was blocked before I could confirm emptiness. A follow-up scout with a working web-search channel should re-try: 'data.gouv.fr' 'meublés tourisme' github mirror, 'dati.gov.it' 'strutture ricettive' github, 'opendata.paris.fr' 'meublé' scraper, and Vienna's 'Kurzzeitvermietungs-Datenbank' / MA specific portals, plus check whether Lisbon's actual RNAL public search portal (rnt.turismodeportugal.pt or similar) has any GitHub scraper — none surfaced here. The strongest single find is the Cádiz/OpenRTA cluster (Inquilinato-Cadiz/mapa best of the four): it demonstrates that Andalucía's regional government exposes a live, CC-BY, 10k-row-capped REST API for STR registrations across an entire tourism-heavy Spanish region, which the team could query directly (bypassing GitHub) for Málaga/Sevilla/Granada coverage beyond what any of these repos captured.
